guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice latency-90 rose from 0.0047 to 0.1454 (z=+602) and latency-50 rose 13x, while its CPU, memory and workload did not increase (workload fell 85%), which points to added delay rather than resource exhaustion. checkoutservice, the only emailservice caller, logs 125 'failed to send order confirmation ... Unavailable' errors, and emailservice logs a TypeError in add_HealthServicer_to_server(), which probably explains the 'no healthy upstream' health-check failures.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect the emailservice pods and network path for injected or real latency, fix the health-servicer registration bug (add_HealthServicer_to_server called without the server argument), then restart or redeploy emailservice and verify checkoutservice order-confirmation errors stop.
